content.text:
Added the limit: Order.Create now fails with "An order can have at most 100 lines." when an order has more than 100 lines. Build and tests pass.

Separate issue I noticed but did not change: the quantity check in Order.Create uses `line.Quantity < 0`, so a line with quantity 0 is accepted even though the error says "Every line needs a positive quantity." It probably should be `<= 0`. Want me to fix that too?
